subject: tr-info
title: (R)TR.INFO.------PROJ.DY.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-8, paired with v1-p146-1. (R)TR-INFO — the reality of trans-information — is crossed with PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). The diagram poses what *real* trans-information (as distinct from any specific transmitted content) looks like when crossed with projectional dynamics. SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) feeds the subject. TR-INFO outputs to POL-P (political policies), to RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits), and to PROJ-DY (the crossing). POL-P then branches to POST (postulation) and LANG-DY (language dynamics). PROJ-DY → UPB (underlying philosophical basis), and UPB branches to WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). Structural argument: real trans-information is downstream of social-reality-dynamics, and *upstream* of political-policies (which produces postulation and language-dynamics), reality-initiative-traits, and projectional-dynamics (which produces UPB itself, branching into world-expansion and time-continuum). The diagram thus situates the underlying-philosophical-basis as the *output* of projectional dynamics fed by trans-information — meaning UPB is not an a-priori platform but a derived structure, exactly the methodological move Braxton is making in this section.
